title: Roots
summary: The 3 cube roots lie on a circle of radius 2.

methods.name: Polar form
methods.reason: Every non-zero complex number has exactly n n-th roots.

steps.title: Use the root formula
steps.text: The \(n\) roots all have modulus \(\sqrt[n]{r}\) and are spread evenly around a circle, \(2\pi/n\) apart.

steps.title: List the roots
steps.text: Take \(k = 0, 1, \ldots, 2\); after that the angles repeat.

steps.title: Check
steps.text: Raising each root to the power 3 gives back z.

methods.verify_note: Raising each root to the power 3 gives back z.
